bounded_output: Every check, input fingerprint and error is retained in numbered SHA256-bound shards, with each file below480000bytes; headline preserves all cost rows, actor/seed matrices and contrasts. No existing attempt is overwritten.
command: python -m experiments.hcsn_blocker_closure_v1.audits.av_outcome_audit audit --study <restored av/results/hosted001> --driver <restored av/results/hosted_driver001> --run-receipt <completed raw REST run JSON> --jobs-receipt <completed raw REST jobs JSON> --output experiments/hcsn_blocker_closure_v1/audits/av_outcome_001.json
independence: Separate reader and arithmetic implementation importing only NumPy/stdlib, written by the study author; another agent independently reviewed the bootstrap, metrics and cost arithmetic. This is computational cross-checking, not an external third-party validation.
numerical_boundary_rule: Preserve the frozen published strict >0 gate. Independently recompute its value and show the frequency-weight result. A sign disagreement with both bootstrap lower bounds within 2e-12 of zero is explicitly ambiguous and cannot independently confirm a positive claim.
outside_scope: A new training experiment or changes to the frozen statistical gate
A full second proof of every kernel/checkpoint/retrieval rank
Foundation-model scale, GPU acceleration or energy superiority

required_inputs.completed_jobs_receipt: Raw GET https://api.github.com/repos/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/41158089224/jobs?per_page=100 with both experiments and publish completed
required_inputs.source_root: The frozen source/dependency tree; AV_DELIVERY and source-map hashes are independently checked

scope: Exact immutable data transport and frozen source map
Exact unique 10+40+40 model/seed/LR job matrix and every attempted worker
Raw audio/video/fused classification and calibration; validation-only LR argmin
Exact eight test actors, 24 clips and six balanced classes per actor; paired eight formal seeds
Eight crossed actor-by-seed bootstrap contrasts via a distinct multinomial-frequency implementation with the registered RNG stream
Full per-worker CPU/wall/RSS, in-memory inference medians and raw complete-update training clocks
Disjoint driver/acquisition CPU lower bound, explicit nested details and unmetered platform CPU/energy
GitHub server-reported complete job wall time, execution span and creation-to-final-completion latency
